---
title: "GitHub Project"
subtitle: "The personal repo, its labels, and the efforts board."
---

Every effort note tagged {{< meta facts.fm.sync_tag >}} is one issue in your personal repo ({{< meta facts.ph.personal_repo >}}), added to one GitHub Project owned by you. `gh-inbox sync` creates and updates them; you read them here and discuss in comments. Sync runs one way, Obsidian → GitHub, so you change efforts in the vault, not here.

## What to check

### The repo

- [ ] {{< meta facts.ph.personal_repo >}} exists on {{< meta facts.ph.host >}}, with Issues enabled, and equals {{< meta facts.key.personal_repo >}} in the [config](config.qmd).
- [ ] Sub-issues are available on the host; the first {{< meta facts.fm.up >}} link of each note becomes the issue's parent.

### Labels

{{< include _partials/labels.qmd >}}

- [ ] There are no hand-made {{< meta facts.label.state_prefix >}} labels besides the six from the effort states table below; `sync` would fight them.
- [ ] {{< meta facts.fm.area_prefix >}} label names match the tags in your notes exactly. `sync` creates missing ones; it doesn't rename.

### The Project and its field

- [ ] The Project is owned by {{< meta facts.ph.user >}} and its URL ends in `/users/<your-user>/projects/<project-number>`, matching {{< meta facts.key.project_owner >}} and {{< meta facts.key.project_number >}}.
- [ ] It has a single-select field named {{< meta facts.project.field >}} (exactly {{< meta facts.key.project_field >}}) with these six options, spelled as shown:

{{< include _partials/effort-states.qmd >}}

- [ ] A board view grouped by {{< meta facts.project.field >}} gives one column per state. Hide `Done` and `Canceled` if you like; they're closed issues.
- [ ] Every effort issue is in the Project. `sync` adds new issues itself; if one is missing, the note probably lacks the {{< meta facts.fm.sync_tag >}} tag.

### The issues

Each issue looks like this:

- **Title**: the note's file name.
- **State**: open, or closed as completed or not planned, per the table above.
- **Labels**: one {{< meta facts.label.state_prefix >}} label and the note's {{< meta facts.fm.area_prefix >}} tags.
- **Parent**: the first {{< meta facts.fm.up >}} link. GitHub allows one parent per sub-issue, so the first link wins. Parents are created before children.
- **Body**: the part between {{< meta facts.marker.body_start >}} and {{< meta facts.marker.body_end >}} belongs to `sync`: the note's Tasks checkboxes with done state, due dates as plain text, and a `Related` line for extra {{< meta facts.fm.up >}} links and all {{< meta facts.fm.related >}} links. **Edits to that part on GitHub are overwritten on the next sync**; anything outside the markers is yours.
- **Comments**: your daily-note log bullets for this effort, one comment per bullet, posted the day after you write them. Discuss here, in comments.

Example issue body:

```markdown
{{< meta facts.marker.body_start >}}
- [ ] Draft the migration plan (due 2026-11-10)
- [x] Get the pipeline green

Related: #17, #23
{{< meta facts.marker.body_end >}}
```

### Promotion to a team repo

When an effort becomes team work:

- **Move**: `gh issue transfer <number> {{< meta facts.ph.team_repo >}} --hostname {{< meta facts.ph.host >}}`. Labels the team repo lacks are dropped, so personal labels stay behind.
- **Copy**: open a new issue on {{< meta facts.ph.team_repo >}} and cross-link it with the personal one.
- Either way, put the new issue's full URL in the note's {{< meta facts.fm.issue_key >}} frontmatter. `sync` matches on the full URL, which is why a new repo and number don't break it.

## How it lines up with the other tools

| Here | Must line up with |
|---|---|
| {{< meta facts.project.field >}} options and {{< meta facts.label.state_prefix >}} labels | The effort folders in the vault ([Obsidian](obsidian.qmd)) and {{< meta facts.key.efforts_table >}} in the [config](config.qmd) |
| Repo, Project owner and number | {{< meta facts.key.personal_repo >}}, {{< meta facts.key.project_owner >}}, {{< meta facts.key.project_number >}} in the [config](config.qmd) |
| Write access to the Project | The `project` token scope ([GitHub settings](github-settings.qmd)) |
| Issue URLs | {{< meta facts.fm.issue_key >}} in each effort note's frontmatter ([Obsidian](obsidian.qmd)) |
| Issue comments | {{< meta facts.vault.log_heading >}} bullets in daily notes ([Obsidian](obsidian.qmd)) |
